integrity: The proof is analytic; finite matrix computations only corroborate it. The related signed-Gaussian Hankel determinant literature poses a remaining equivalence risk, and independent examination has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes the centered positive half-line for the one-dimensional normalized harmonic oscillator; the Barnes limit applies only to an even-dimensional consecutive low-pass mask. No individual off-center eigenvalue formulas or shifted-cut claims are made.
title: Half-line Hermite spectral gaps: arbitrary-mask Cauchy formula and a Barnes limit
